questions.prompt_en: Traditional local festivals are becoming less popular among some young people. What problems can this cause, and what solutions could help? Write at least 250 words.
questions.prompt_vi: Separate problems and solutions, give specific actions and maintain formal tone.

answer.model_en:
In some communities, fewer young people take part in traditional festivals. This trend may weaken cultural knowledge and reduce opportunities for different generations to spend time together. However, schools and local organisers can take practical steps to make festivals more meaningful to younger residents.

One problem is that customs may gradually be forgotten. Many festivals include stories, music and activities that are not regularly taught elsewhere. If young people stop participating, they may know little about why these traditions matter. A second issue is the loss of community connections. Festivals often bring neighbours and relatives together, and without these events young people may have fewer chances to meet older members of their community. This could create a wider gap between generations. Over time, local organisations might also lose volunteers who once helped to prepare performances, decorations and other festival activities.

There are several possible solutions. First, schools could organise projects in which students interview family members about local celebrations and present what they have learned. This would help them understand traditions rather than simply memorise dates. Second, festival organisers could invite young volunteers to plan activities, prepare publicity or explain the meaning of ceremonies to visitors. Online videos could also introduce the festival to a wider audience, although digital content should support real participation rather than replace it.

In conclusion, declining interest in traditional festivals can damage cultural awareness and community relationships. By involving young people in the preparation and explanation of events, schools and local groups can help preserve traditions while allowing them to remain relevant today.
